messages.subject: Plot predictions with 95% CI
parts:
Hello all unmarked users,

I hope you all are safe during the Covid-19 pandemic period.

 I am sorry for my very basic question but I cannot find a way to solve it. I used “single season single species model in unmarked” and I want to produce a “Plot predictions with 95% CI” from the best candidate model.

> newData1 <- data.frame(dog=seq(min(dog),max(dog),length.out = 53))

> E.p <- predict(Model21, type="det", newdata=newData1, appendData=TRUE)

> head(E.p)

### To plot the detection probability with 95% CI

> plot(Predicted ~ dog, E.p, type="l", ylim=c(0,1),

+      xlab="Capture rate of humans",

+      ylab="Expected detection probability")

> lines(lower ~ dog, E.p, type="l", col=gray(0.5))

> lines(upper ~ dog, E.p, type="l", col=gray(0.5))

### the following figures were out both for detection and occupancy probability. These figures are not the same like the other people’ figures. I really cannot understand why.

My question is “Could you please suggest me how to fix this problem?” Thank you so much for all your kind help and all your efforts for answering the questions.


Best Regards,
